rv.q: I’ve seen a few good ones at the National - thinking back a (good) bit to Ayckbourn’s A Small Family Business and more recently Nine Night in the Dorfman. But this kitchen, in Julie, is the biggest kitchen that you or I are ever likely to come across anytime, anywhere, anyhow.

In this modern dress adaptation of Strindberg's 1888 1 Act play, MISS JULIE, It’s Julie’s (Vanessa Kirby) birthday and she’s throwing a massive party at her father’s mansion. People come in and out of the house but there is a feeling of boredom around Julie.
